create_silence.description: Silence the alerts the matchers pick for a length of time or until a moment, now or from a later start, such as during a deploy. They keep firing in Alertmanager but notify no one.
create_silence.name: create_silence

parameters.description: Which alerts to silence, one matcher per line, such as alertname=DiskFull and instance=~"db-.*". An alert's labels from a trigger work too.
parameters.name: matchers

parameters.description: How long it lasts, or type one such as 90m or 1d 12h. Defaults to 2 hours.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: When it ends, instead of a length of time.
parameters.name: ends_at

parameters.description: When it starts, such as a maintenance window's start. Leave blank for now.
parameters.name: starts_at

parameters.description: Who it is from, shown in Alertmanager. Defaults to Lodol.
parameters.name: created_by

parameters.description: Why, shown in Alertmanager, such as Deploying release 4.2.
parameters.name: comment

matchers_text.description: Its matchers on one line, comma-separated

minutes_left.description: Whole minutes until it ends; 0 once expired

updated_at.description: When it last changed, in UTC (ISO 8601)

expire_silence.description: End a silence now, so its alerts notify again. One already ended is left as it is.
expire_silence.name: expire_silence

parameters.description: The silence: pick it, or give its ID from Create silence, List silences or a trigger.
parameters.name: silence

already_expired.description: True when it had already ended, so nothing changed

matchers_text.description: Its matchers on one line, comma-separated

minutes_left.description: Whole minutes until it ends; 0 once expired

updated_at.description: When it last changed, in UTC (ISO 8601)

get_silence.description: Get one silence: what it matches, who created it and why, when it ends, and its state.
get_silence.name: get_silence

parameters.description: The silence: pick it, or give its ID from Create silence, List silences or a trigger.
parameters.name: silence

matchers_text.description: Its matchers on one line, comma-separated

minutes_left.description: Whole minutes until it ends; 0 once expired

updated_at.description: When it last changed, in UTC (ISO 8601)

get_status.description: Get Alertmanager's version, when it started, its cluster's members and its configuration as loaded (secrets hidden).

resolve_alert.description: Mark a firing alert resolved now, found by its fingerprint or by the name and labels it was sent with. For alerts a workflow sent: Prometheus sends its own again while they still fire.
resolve_alert.name: resolve_alert

parameters.description: The alert's fingerprint (from a trigger, List alerts or Send alert), or its name, such as BackupFailed.

parameters.description: With a name: the other labels it was sent with, severity too. Leave blank for a fingerprint.
parameters.name: labels

was_firing.description: True when it was firing and is now resolved; false when no such alert was firing, so nothing changed

send_alert.description: Send an alert to Alertmanager, which routes it to its receivers like one from Prometheus. Without an end, it resolves itself after 5 minutes (Alertmanager's resolve_timeout) unless sent again; use Resolve alert to end it sooner.

parameters.description: Its severity label, such as critical, warning or info, which routes often send to different receivers.
parameters.name: severity

parameters.description: Other labels, such as instance db-1 and team database. The same name and labels make the same alert.

description: Work with Prometheus Alertmanager: silence alerts during a deploy or from a chat button, expire and list silences, list firing alerts, and send and resolve alerts of your own. Start a workflow when an alert fires or resolves, or a silence is created or about to end.

alertmanager_alert_firing_trigger.description: Runs when an alert starts firing in Alertmanager, not silenced or inhibited. Alerts already firing when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only alerts whose labels match, such as alertname=DiskFull or severity=critical, comma-separated. Leave blank for every alert.
parameters.name: matchers

parameters.description: Only alerts sent to this receiver. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: receiver

alertmanager_alert_resolved_trigger.description: Runs when an alert Alertmanager was holding is resolved, with the alert as it was last seen, such as to close the ticket it opened.

parameters.description: Only alerts whose labels match, such as alertname=DiskFull or severity=critical, comma-separated. Leave blank for every alert.
parameters.name: matchers

parameters.description: Only alerts sent to this receiver. Leave blank for any.
parameters.name: receiver

alertmanager_silence_created_trigger.description: Runs when someone creates a silence, active or starting later, with who made it, why, what it matches and when it ends.

parameters.description: Only silences of alerts with these labels, such as alertname=DiskFull. Leave blank for every silence.
parameters.name: matchers

alertmanager_silence_ending_trigger.description: Runs when an active silence is about to end, such as to ask whether to extend it. Silences already that close when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only silences of alerts with these labels, such as alertname=DiskFull. Leave blank for every silence.
parameters.name: matchers

parameters.description: How long before it ends to run, such as 30m or 2h. Leave blank for 30 minutes.
parameters.name: within
